cancellation_summary: Any changes or cancellations must be made at least 3 days (72 hours) prior to your reservation start date for a full refund.
description: Embark on a memorable guided kayak tour under the iconic Coronado Bridge in San Diego Bay.
what_is_included: Departing from Coronado, this tour welcomes all skill levels and offers both single and tandem kayaks. Paddle along the picturesque waterfront, taking in stunning views of the city skyline and the majestic bridge overhead. Keep an eye out for local marine life as you explore the bay with expert guidance. Whether you're a seasoned paddler or new to kayaking, this tour promises an unforgettable adventure on the water.
